body.message:
Thank you for allowing me the opportunity to view unit 407 in the Elite Business Bay Residences.  The location is good and the apartment is not a bad size.  The beds, bathrooms and balcony all offer exactly what I needed.  However, I need a kitchen with an oven.  I cook a lot and would find only have a hob and microwave somewhat limiting.  I must also say I was disappointed with the condition of the furniture.  The dining table was badly damaged and sofas were well beyond their best - to the point where two of the seat were not even usable.  All of the walls are covered in handprints and greasy marks, and one of the bedroom walls has been drawn on.  
I am afraid this is not the apartment for me, and not somewhere I would want to bring my wife.  
If you have anything else that you think might be suitable I would be interested so see them.  It does not have to be in Business Bay.  I would be happy to look at other areas - Arjan, Greens, Marina, JBR, - essentially anywhere that has access to the Metro or the Tram.  
Apologies for the feedback, but as someone who has worked in hospitality for over 25 years, I think it is important to explain the reasoning behind a decision.
